cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (microexon 34' splicing not affected)
cases.mechanism_detail: Cell-based splicing assays, RT-PCR and Nanopore long-read sequencing of XDP vs control brain TAF1 mRNA showed the SVA does not reduce inclusion of neuron-specific microexon 34' and transcript architecture is similar; the authors discount 34' mis-splicing as the disease mechanism.
cases.quote: Using cell-based splicing assays, we demonstrate that presence of the disease-associated SINE-VNTR-Alu does not affect the inclusion of microexon 34′.
